metadata.title: Withdraw from the contract
metadata.description: Withdraw online from a contract concluded in the M'Arte shop, within 14 days of receiving your order.

page.title: Withdraw from the contract
page.intro: As a consumer, you may withdraw from a contract concluded in our shop within 14 days of receiving the products, without giving a reason. Fill in this form to send us your statement of withdrawal. We will confirm that we received it by email, to the address you placed the order with.
page.accountHint: Have an account? You can also withdraw on the order's page in <link>your orders</link>.
page.itemsHint: For example the product names and how many of each.

form.name: Your full name
form.scopeLegend: I withdraw from the contract for
form.reasonHint: You do not have to give a reason.

account.title: Withdrawal from the contract
account.description: You may withdraw from this contract within 14 days of receiving the products, without giving a reason.
account.dialogDescription: Your statement of withdrawal from the contract for order {orderNumber}. We will confirm that we received it by email to {email}.

result.recorded: We have received your statement of withdrawal
result.acknowledged: On {date} we received it and emailed a confirmation with its content to {email}.
result.notAcknowledged: We recorded it on {date}, but could not email the confirmation to {email}. Please keep this page, or write to us at {shopEmail} and we will send it again.
result.notFound: We could not find this order among your orders.
result.closed: The withdrawal period for this order has ended, or the order was cancelled. If you think this is a mistake, write to us at {shopEmail}.
result.alreadyWithdrawn: You have already withdrawn from the contract for the whole of this order.
result.submittedDescription: If an order with this number was placed with this email address and can still be withdrawn from, we have recorded your statement of withdrawal and are emailing that address a confirmation with its content and the date and time it reached us. If no confirmation arrives within a few minutes, check the order number and the email address in your order confirmation and send the form again, or write to us at {shopEmail}.

validation.nameMaxLength: Your name can be at most 256 characters long.
validation.orderNumberRequired: Enter the order number from your confirmation email.
validation.orderNumberMaxLength: An order number is at most 32 characters long.
validation.emailInvalid: Enter the email address you ordered with.
validation.itemsRequired: Say which products you are withdrawing from.
